summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated November 12, 2026 reporting third-quarter 2026 results. Distributable earnings before realizations rose 16% year over year to $5.8 billion for the last twelve months, with net income of $1.9 billion for the quarter and $5.3 billion LTM; DE per share was $0.73 for the quarter. The company disclosed over $300 million of share repurchases since its last report and roughly $900 million year-to-date. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; this is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
